interpretation: This is a reviewed source/mechanism inventory. Neither mapped/full nor a valid hash certifies execution. Clean final-HEAD receipts and external acceptance are separate.

mechanisms.mechanism: WAL object-store PUT held separately from reply dispatch
mechanisms.entered_proof: WAL hold counter, applied closed state, absent Remote tail, subsequent enqueued retry/fence and fence generation 2
mechanisms.oracle: No success until actual Remote tail; no reply until dispatch release; all replies closed and reopened tail closed
mechanisms.limitations: In-memory object store behind pinned SlateDB; real Prisma Compute/Tigris run pending.

mechanisms.mechanism: Count-preserving lost-record/duplicate swap
mechanisms.entered_proof: Acknowledged and observed vector counts equal before audit
mechanisms.oracle: Swapped set rejected with loss or duplicate invariant; faithful set accepted
mechanisms.limitations: Pure oracle control; no claim that fleet schedules were executed.

mechanisms.mechanism: Actual segment-derived key/frame nonce construction including forced nonce repetition and rollback
mechanisms.entered_proof: Same offset and forced identical nonce across segment and replacement payload invocations
mechanisms.oracle: No repeated GCM keystream; decrypt authentic frames; exact RFC8452 and frame vectors; legacy/new readback
mechanisms.limitations: Independent cryptographic design review and namespace/backend rollout remain pending.

mechanisms.mechanism: Each required durable accounting read fails before transaction commit
mechanisms.entered_proof: Injected read failures and concurrently newer dirty version
mechanisms.oracle: No partial batch acknowledgment/accounting advance; failed group preserves dirty version and exact retry state
mechanisms.limitations: Production billing reconciliation remains pending.

mechanisms.mechanism: Required metadata reads fail and persisted rows/keys are corrupt
mechanisms.entered_proof: Per-read injection and malformed watermark/close-key fixtures
mechanisms.oracle: Exact row/checkpoint bytes remain unchanged; finalization cannot certify incomplete input

configuration.failure_model: read error and corrupt durable input

mechanisms.limitations: Live ledger/rollup reconciliation across production restarts remains pending.

mechanisms.mechanism: Actual HTTP body polling sentinel
mechanisms.entered_proof: Raw/product requests exercise valid bodyless and unauthorized mutations, signed and expired capability tokens
mechanisms.oracle: Body poll count remains zero at required boundary; exact response classification
mechanisms.limitations: Configured production authentication deployment leg remains pending.

mechanisms.mechanism: Required task returns Done, Failed, or panics after /readyz first succeeds
mechanisms.entered_proof: Park/release oneshot; await critical failure registration
mechanisms.oracle: Both /readyz and /health return 503 with failed task identity; shutdown controls covered by registry tests
mechanisms.limitations: Process drain/restart policy in live fleet remains pending.

mechanisms.mechanism: Controlled cached-token expiry concurrency and late old-generation 401
mechanisms.entered_proof: All old-token requests entered before refresh release
mechanisms.oracle: One provider refresh shared; late failures reuse newer token; rejection delivered to all waiters and subsequent acquisition recovers
mechanisms.limitations: Bun/Deno/live auth exchanges require external runtime receipts.

tests.name: cached concurrent expiry shares one refresh and late 401s reuse it
refresh rejection reaches every waiter and subsequent acquisition recovers
synchronous provider failure is single-flight and recoverable

mechanisms.mechanism: Held first append, queued epoch bump/batch/seal and injected fetch/save failures; sparse scope churn
mechanisms.entered_proof: First append entered before enqueue; one million unique keys, peak128 held operations
mechanisms.oracle: Exact wire sequence/epoch; failures remain caller-visible; every completed/rejected chain evicts
mechanisms.limitations: Local queue and mocked fetch proof; multi-runtime real-server ordering remains pending.

tests.name: append, epoch bump, batch append and final seal share one scope order
fetch failure propagates and does not poison subsequent producer operations
state-save failure propagates and a same-payload retry preserves sequence
automatic reclaim completes within the queue before a later epoch bump
one million sparse producer scopes release every fulfilled and rejected chain

mechanisms.mechanism: Break/throw/return cleanup after recorded per-message decisions and parked pull cancellation
mechanisms.entered_proof: A yielded message or pending pull entered before consumer cancellation
mechanisms.oracle: Only processed decisions settle once; undecided messages retained; settlement/handler errors remain observable
mechanisms.limitations: Live consumer lease timing and Bun/Deno remain pending.

tests.name: ack then break submits only the yielded message's decision
handler throw settles recorded decisions and retains the handler exception
settlement failure surfaces on break and remains visible beside handler failure
iterator return cancels an in-flight parked pull

mechanisms.mechanism: 421 and 503 header/body wrong-cell, permanent auth/domain failures, status backoff and transport rollback
mechanisms.entered_proof: Mock fetch/provider counters and body cancellation; actual 5000ms backoff timer is captured and its callback withheld. Operation remains pending before abort, then completes and clears that timer while callback remains withheld.
mechanisms.oracle: Permanent failures surfaced after one request; no auth refresh on wrong-cell; transient recovery resumes durable cursor
mechanisms.limitations: Live server compatibility and Bun/Deno smoke remain pending.

tests.name: wrong-cell after one request and no refresh
subscription propagates permanent token-provider failures without any fetch
cancellation interrupts status backoff without replay
header wrong-cell cancels an unused response body
explicitly permanent 503 domain errors are not replayed

mechanisms.owner: Billing owned active pass and tombstone cursor
mechanisms.mechanism: Cancel both real entered spool PUT and catalog LIST; enumerate a 513-entry catalog in one bounded page per pass
mechanisms.entered_proof: FaultStore hold counters for PUT/SST seed 910 and LIST/Other seed 909 are both nonzero; read batch has left the queue before shutdown
mechanisms.oracle: Both tasks finish cooperatively without hard abort; exact source/sequence/bytes are recovered and retried; incomplete catalog cursor stays unchanged; completed page cursors are bounded-255, bounded-511, then None
mechanisms.limitations: Pinned local SlateDB and in-memory object store; live storage cancellation/debt reconciliation remains pending.

mechanisms.mechanism: Cancel an entered open before it returns and separately discard an already queued database result
mechanisms.entered_proof: Oneshot proves worker entry; receiver cancellation is awaited before worker release; queued-result test proves successful send before receiver drop
mechanisms.oracle: Actual Db observer reads succeed for the live control and fail after abandoned-result cleanup; ownership covers both late completion and channel-queued result
mechanisms.limitations: Local database ownership cleanup; deployment process shutdown behavior still requires live campaign evidence.

mechanisms.owner: Ops/audit batch guards and fleet durable outbox
mechanisms.mechanism: Cancel entered batch append; restore older events ahead of concurrent arrivals; overflow requeue; cancel fleet append and actual fleet CAS clear
mechanisms.entered_proof: Sink notification occurs after dequeue; fleet CAS-clear FaultStore PUT/Fleet hold counter is observed after successful append
mechanisms.oracle: Original event order and deterministic IDs survive cancellation and failed retry, successful retry disarms requeue; bounded overflow restores prior 17-event gap plus one new loss; fleet source stays durable until append and exact-ID clear succeed
mechanisms.limitations: Ops/audit use a controlled entered append sink; fleet clear uses actual in-memory ObjectStore CAS. Production restart/ledger reconciliation remains pending.

mechanisms.mechanism: Repeated known-segment appends at full sketch population; replacement epoch positive control
mechanisms.entered_proof: Fill SKETCH_MAX including target sibling segments and count actual incarnation cleanup entries visited
mechanisms.oracle: All 256 steady appends visit zero unrelated entries; changed epoch visits the populated cleanup set and removes old sibling sketches, hot state and cooldowns while preserving the new epoch
mechanisms.limitations: Operation-count regression proves the fast path; production latency/allocation/storage-request comparisons remain pending.

mechanisms.mechanism: Distinct limits, owned monotonic refill, admitted counters and lag/pending maps across live runtimes
mechanisms.entered_proof: Actual HTTP accepted/refused appends and durable counter updates; separate ManualClock wall and monotonic changes
mechanisms.oracle: Different runtime ceilings and counters never cross-charge; same runtime engines share one budget; teardown/restart releases state
mechanisms.limitations: Controlled local runtime/object-store execution; external Prisma Compute/Tigris and production performance remain separate acceptance legs.

mechanisms.owner: RuntimeCaps telemetry, ops/audit and store I/O resources
mechanisms.mechanism: Per-runtime queues/alerts/body ceilings/Foyer cache/progress/physical permit budgets
mechanisms.entered_proof: Two real HTTP runtimes, real telemetry databases, and TimingStore entry/held permits
mechanisms.oracle: No cross-drain, cross-resolve, shared first-touch capacity or wrong-runtime permit accounting; owned cancellation and teardown release resources

mechanisms.mechanism: Actual source ledger GET and immutable artifact PUT held inside active passes
mechanisms.entered_proof: Entered operation counters observed before supervised cancellation
mechanisms.oracle: Clean cooperative task completion preserves ledger offsets and artifact debt; retry bills once and publishes exact artifact
mechanisms.limitations: Controlled local runtime/object-store execution; external Prisma Compute/Tigris and production performance remain separate acceptance legs.

mechanisms.mechanism: Real active budget reservation and history SST PUT, registered engine task and close watch
mechanisms.entered_proof: Reservation slot enters while all bytes are held, or data SST PUT enters; actual engine workers join before release and the sole store-close owner joins after release
mechanisms.oracle: Cancellation releases task/budget and lag state; durable dirty marker remains for a fresh owner to absorb exact data
mechanisms.limitations: Controlled local runtime/object-store execution; external Prisma Compute/Tigris and production performance remain separate acceptance legs.

mechanisms.mechanism: Serialize exact JSON byte budgets including arrays and escaped strings; oversized event emits an explicit gap
mechanisms.entered_proof: Actual selected queue prefix, cancellation guard drop and 64KiB journal append contract
mechanisms.oracle: Unselected/cancelled events keep exact order; oversized records cannot wedge followers or silently erase drop magnitude
mechanisms.limitations: Controlled local runtime/object-store execution; external Prisma Compute/Tigris and production performance remain separate acceptance legs.

mechanisms.mechanism: Entered heartbeat/read/CAS operations with streamed-body and complete ownership snapshot bounds
mechanisms.entered_proof: Real held GET/PUT entries; misleading body metadata and exact paused-time deadlines
mechanisms.oracle: Cooperative shutdown, no partial ring/override publication, no corrupt-body empty view, deterministic durable retry after release

configuration.publication_validation: same semantic validators as reads, before storage

mechanisms.limitations: Controlled local runtime/object-store execution; external Prisma Compute/Tigris and production performance remain separate acceptance legs.

mechanisms.mechanism: Durable parent close parked before successor CAS, cancellation and deadline rotation
mechanisms.entered_proof: Actual phase-B failpoint entry after parent close
mechanisms.oracle: Descriptor intent survives; wrong incarnation cannot resume; healthy queued stream progresses; matching retry completes once
mechanisms.limitations: Controlled local runtime/object-store execution; external Prisma Compute/Tigris and production performance remain separate acceptance legs.
